label: Q-04
title: Single aggregate slippage bound: intermediate legs run with minOut 0 / no price limit, harvest() has no deadline and accepts minEthOut=0; MEV exposure if the private relay leaks
description: By-design single end-to-end minEthOut bound (src/CLAUDE.md 'One slippage check'); no deadline parameter.
impact: Caller-only, sub-dollar at current sizes, scales linearly with pending yield; protocol not exposed (SYA payment independent of sale price, ECON-003).
severityRationale: Single end-to-end minEthOut bound is a documented design decision; exposure is caller-only and sub-dollar at current sizes, and a public-mempool leak needs the operator to bypass the private relay. A direct caller passing minEthOut=0 is user input. Deadline sub-issue counted once under Q-07.
